credits.title: Firecrow
credits.overview: Two farm workers move a cryptic scarecrow one day, which unbeknownst to them, has been afflicted with a powerful curse.

credits.title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
credits.overview: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

credits.title: Cold Road
credits.overview: On a frozen remote highway in the Canadian North, an Indigenous woman and her dog are hunted by a stranger in a semi truck.

credits.title: Pest
credits.overview: A woman calls over a pest controller to deal with an infestation in her house, but not of termites...

credits.title: Side Walks
credits.overview: Two twenty-somethings, unrelated, struggle to maintain their personal relationships going about their day-to-day life in Vancouver.
